metadata.description: Claude Code mods: live panes, guards and model routing.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Routes each turn to the cheapest model + effort that fits, with a live cost-ladder pane.

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing how full the context window is, with a nudge to compact.

plugins.name: safety-net
plugins.description: Blocks destructive shell commands and writes to secret files before they run.

plugins.name: secret-scrubber
plugins.description: Redacts API keys and tokens from tool output before the transcript and the model see them.

plugins.name: turn-recap
plugins.description: Adds a one-line TL;DR, written by Haiku 5.5, under long answers.

plugins.name: ping
plugins.description: A chime and a toast when a long turn finishes or is waiting for your approval.
